body.name: etaU
body.sig: \(\eta^{\mathrm U}_{no}=c_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U})/a_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U})\) when \(a_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U})>0\), and \(\eta^{\mathrm U}_{no}=0\) otherwise
body.def: The exact rational posterior-mean estimator generated cell by cell from \(\pi^{\mathrm U}\) and the corrected kernel \(K\); this formula is a complete coordinate specification because every \(a_{no}\) and \(c_{no}\) is a finite rational sum.
